definitions.explanation: Literally 'ten thousand thunderclaps.' Used almost exclusively in the set phrase 万雷の拍手 (thunderous applause) to describe extremely loud, enthusiastic clapping from an audience.

examples.japanese: {万雷|ばんらい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{拍手|はくしゅ}→拍手：03553_hakushu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
⟦{演奏|えんそう}→演奏：01896_ensou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{終|お}わる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{万雷|ばんらい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{拍手|はくしゅ}→拍手：03553_hakushu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{送|おく}られた→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: When the performance ended, thunderous applause was given.

examples.japanese: ⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}→優勝：03647_yuushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧⟦{瞬間|しゅんかん}→瞬間：03226_shunkan⟧、⟦スタジアム→スタジアム：23905_sutajiamu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{万雷|ばんらい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{拍手|はくしゅ}→拍手：03553_hakushu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{歓声|かんせい}→歓声：02686_kansei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}まれた→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧。
examples.english: The moment the championship was decided, the stadium was engulfed in thunderous applause and cheers.

notes:
{万雷|ばんらい} is almost always used in the fixed phrase {万雷|ばんらい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{拍手|はくしゅ}→拍手：03553_hakushu⟧ (thunderous applause). It is rarely used independently. The word evokes the image of ten thousand thunderbolts striking at once.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {万雷|ばんらい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{拍手|はくしゅ}→拍手：03553_hakushu⟧ — thunderous applause
- {万雷|ばんらい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{拍手|はくしゅ}→拍手：03553_hakushu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧ — thunderous applause breaks out
- {万雷|ばんらい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{拍手|はくしゅ}→拍手：03553_hakushu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浴|あ}びる→浴びる：02844_abiru⟧ — to receive thunderous applause

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{拍手|はくしゅ}→拍手：03553_hakushu⟧ — applause, clapping
- ⟦{喝采|かっさい}→喝采：08383_kassai⟧ — cheers, acclaim
- ⟦{歓声|かんせい}→歓声：02686_kansei⟧ — cheers, shouts of joy
